description: This PHP file handles the import process of modules or language packs within the vtiger CRM application. It manages file uploads, package validation, and configuration of module import steps, including directory management, license checking, and displaying relevant templates.

classes.name: Vtiger_Package
classes.description: Represents a package (module or language) in vtiger CRM, providing methods for validation, metadata extraction, and license checks.

classes.name: Vtiger_Language
classes.description: Represents a language pack package in vtiger CRM.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A subclass or wrapper for Smarty template engine used within vtiger CRM for rendering views.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues like XSS.

methods.name: checkFileAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory is accessible and writable.
